description: Fetch the full markdown content of a Mintive documentation page by its id. Use it after search (or list_docs) to read a page in full before answering, for example the Snowflake connector setup, the SCIM provisioning guide, or the tool governance reference. If you have a public docs URL or a slug instead of a search-result id, use get_page.

id.description: The document id returned by search or list_docs.

name: fetch
title: Fetch a Mintive docs page
